metadata.description: Bounded directed paths between explicitly selected visual and descending endpoints. Roles assigned by MetroFly.

pathQueries: MATCH (s:Neuron {bodyId: 11139}), (t:Neuron {bodyId: 11074}) MATCH p=allShortestPaths((s)-[:ConnectsTo*1..8]->(t)) WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.weight >= 5) AND all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n:Neuron) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.bodyId] AS ids LIMIT 3

methodology.verification: Fresh queries for every retained identity, annotation, directed pair and exact raw weight.
